paper_title: Flattening Every Memory Peak in Long-Context Mixture-of-Experts Training

sections.title: Abstract
sections.content: Training a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model at long context or large batch size fails as soon as any one component's peak allocation exceeds device memory, so the target is every peak at once, not the average footprint. Four are left unbounded by the parallelism plans in common use, and each grows differently: expert dispatch with the routing matrix, the vocabulary projection with tokens times vocabulary, gradient checkpoint boundaries with depth times sequence length, and optimizer state with parameter count. Which one runs out first changes with the model, the context length, and the device count, so lowering the largest only exposes the next. We bound all four with schedules whose GPU working set is fixed at launch: PipelinedLLEP extends least-loaded expert parallelism with a cap on the tokens each source contributes to a dispatch chunk, Ring-DTP circulates activations or weight shards around a ring at the vocabulary projection and folds each block of logits into an online log-sum-exp, Selective checkpoint offload (SCO) keeps the one long-lived tensor of each checkpoint boundary in CPU memory, and OffloadStreamAdamW turns the serial CPU Adam update of optimizer offload into a bucket pipeline. All four change only the order and granularity of computation and data movement, so the loss and gradients stay exact. In matched component tests, they cut the MoE dispatch peak by up to $59.3\%$ without losing throughput, the vocabulary projection peak by $86.6\%$, and the offloaded optimizer step by $2.05\times$ faster. Composed on MoE models from 120B to 667B parameters, they train at 1M context length, $8$--$32\times$ the reach of a tuned FSDP2 baseline, and up to $10.4\times$ its throughput.

sections.title: INTRODUCTION
sections.content: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models are often trained at long context or large batch size at large scale of compute. However, when adding GPUs is rarely the available remedy, memory is traded for time. Every standard trade charges time: gradient checkpointing recomputes (Chen et al., 2016; Korthikanti et al., 2023), state sharding communicates (Rajbhandari et al., 2020; Zhao et al., 2023), and optimizer offload serializes the update on the host (Ren et al., 2021). training step dies when any components peak memory occupancy exceeds the devices capacity. So plan that reduces three bottlenecks and leaves the fourth free to grow with the workload buys nothing at the point where the workload grows. Reaching longer context, or larger batches, or large model sizes means holding every component under the device ceiling at the same time. Which peak runs out first depends on the configuration. Peak memory is maximum over live sets, the groups of tensors that must be resident simultaneously. In this work, we explore four components that are left unbounded by the parallelism plans in common use: expert dispatch grows with the routing matrix the router draws (Lepikhin et al., 2020; Rajbhandari et al., 2022), the vocabulary projection with the token-vocabulary product (Wijmans et al., 2025), retained gradient checkpointing boundaries with depth times sequence length (Chen et al., 2016), and AdamW state with parameter count (Loshchilov and Hutter, 2019). Because these grow at different rates, the largest of the four depends specific configuration: logits dominate at large vocabulary and long context, MoE dispatch at high routing imbalance, checkpointing boundaries at high depth, and optimizer state at large parameter count on few devices. usable stack needs bound on every term rather than large saving on one, and each bound has to be separately enableable so training run pays only for the peaks it has, which is why the four operators below are developed together. All four change only the order and granularity of computation and data movement, leaving the model, the parameterization, the optimizer, the precision, and the 1 Preprint Salesforce AI Research loss untouched: no low-rank adapters, no quantized state (Dettmers et al., 2022), and no approximate routing or attention. Memory and throughput figures are therefore directly comparable with standard full-parameter BF16 training. Four bounded-streaming operators. Each operator takes one established component, identifies what that component leaves unbounded, and replaces its schedule. (i) Expert parallelism shards experts across ranks (GPUs), so rank must hold every token routed to the experts it owns, and the router decides how many that is (Lepikhin et al., 2020; Rajbhandari et al., 2022). Least-loaded expert parallelism (LLEP) removes the time cost of routing skew by moving routed work to idle ranks without changing any tokens expert choice (Nguyen et al., 2026a), but rank still allocates for its whole routed batch at once. Our proposed PipelinedLLEP delivers the same routes in chunks and caps the tokens any source may place in chunk, so receivers buffers follow that cap and routing skew lengthens the schedule instead of enlarging the buffers. (ii) The vocabulary projection materializes tokens-by-vocabulary logit tensor, which dominates memory once both factors are large. Fused cross-entropy kernels avoid it on single device by streaming the log-sum-exp over vocabulary blocks (Wijmans et al., 2025; Hsu et al., 2024), and Megatron shards the weight but requires every rank to hold the same batch (Shoeybi et al., 2019), reducing effective batch size. Our Ring-DTP (ring data-tensor-parallel vocabulary projection) lets each rank keep its own distinct batch and circulates either the activations or the weight shards around ring until every batch has met every shard, the exact loss and gradients are computed yet the large tensor is never formed. (iii) Gradient checkpointing buys memory with recomputation, yet one tensor per checkpointed layer, its input, still lives from the forward pass until that layer is recomputed (Chen et al., 2016). Our SCO (selective checkpoint offload) offloads host-budget subset of those inputs into host memory, and prefetches them back one layer before the layer is recomputed. (iv) Optimizer offload stores AdamW state on CPU RAM, but CPU update operation is slow, during which the GPU is idle and, having released its activations, nearly empty (Ren et al., 2021). Instead, our OffloadStreamAdamW (streamed offloaded AdamW) streams the parameters from host RAM to GPUs and compute the weight update there and write back. It leverages communication-computpation overlap to maximize the efficiency. Individual improvements. Each operator is measured against the baseline that solves the same problem, on identical input (3). PipelinedLLEP lowers the MoE dispatch peak by up to 59.3% against LLEP and runs with no noticeable slowdown against it. Ring-DTP removes 86.6% of the vocabulary projection peak for under 5% more time. SCO lowers the device peak monotonically in the host budget it is given, moves throughput by under 2%, and raises the largest batch that completes by 17.7%. OffloadStreamAdamW runs the offloaded optimizer step 2.05 faster than the CPU AdamW it replaces. We compose the four operators inside the Mixture-of-Parallelisms (MoP) rank layout (Nguyen et al., 2026b). End to end on MoE models of 120B, 241B, and 667B parameters, the composed stack trains at one-million context length, 832 the reach of tuned FSDP2 baseline, at up to 10.4 its throughput and up to 12 its largest global batch (4).

sections.title: 3.4 OFFLOADSTREAMADAMW: BOUNDED GPU UPDATES OVER HOST CPU STATE
sections.content: When HBM capacity is at the limit, it makes sense to offload the optimizer and its state to CPU (Ren et al., 2021; Rajbhandari et al., 2021), and the price is that CPU AdamW update is slow, during that time the GPU device is idle and, having released its activations, largely empty in the HBM. We make use of the idle GPU as the update engine by streaming CPU-resident states to GPU and back. Specifically, OffloadStreamAdamW partitions each ranks state into buckets of at most β parameters and rotates them through staging slots and three streams: (i) host-to-device transfer of master weights, moments, and final gradients; (ii) fused GPU AdamW update and bf16 working-weight refresh; and (iii) write-back of updated fp32 state (Figure 5). For buckets, Tstream = max(TH2D, Tupdate, TD2H) + O(TH2D + Tupdate + TD2H), Mstage = O(sβ). (5) The floor for any offloaded optimizer is the host-link round trip of 12Θ/W bytes, so the design goal is to hide the update and the write-back behind that transfer. Isolated benchmark. Table 4 compares the OffloadStreamAdamW against the AVX CPU Adam kernel of ZeRO-Offload (Ren et al., 2021) that it replaces, with the same fp32 master weights and moments on the host in both cases. Rotating the same update through the idle GPU takes the step from 3.95 to 1.93 s, 2.05 speedup. Two slots are enough to keep the transfer stream busy. Making the queue deeper but increasing staging slots leaves step time unchanged. That insensitivity to is consistent with the pipeline being transfer-bound at the 12Θ/W host-link floor of Equation (5).

sections.title: 5 RELATED WORK
sections.content: Parallelism and expert dispatch. Megatron-style tensor, sequence, and pipeline parallelism factor devices into global grid (Shoeybi et al., 2019; Korthikanti et al., 2023), ZeRO and FSDP shard model state (Rajbhandari et al., 2020; Zhao et al., 2023), expert parallelism partitions sparse experts (Rajbhandari et al., 2022), Ulysses shards long sequences (Jacobs et al., 2023), and MoP assigns schedule per component over overlapping sub-groups of one rank set (Nguyen et al., 2026b); this paper supplies the operator definitions, bounds, exactness conditions, and mechanism-level evaluation that layout leaves unspecified. FasterMoE, Lina, PipeMoE, and ScheMoE partition dispatch to overlap communication, choosing the partition count for bandwidth utilization (He et al., 2022; Li et al., 2023; Shi et al., 2023; 2024), which sizes the receive buffer before the partition is applied and leaves the footprint following the realized load. PipelinedLLEP asks the different question of what destination may receive, and answers it with token budget on each source, chunk membership policy that relocated assignment plan requires, and nested checkpoint contract that holds the resulting bound through checkpointed backward. Placement methods redistribute skew across devices (Zhai et al., 2023; Nie et al., 2023; Nguyen et al., 2026a) and compose with the budget, since placement fitted to observed co-selection statistics carries no guarantee for the next routing matrix. Streamed losses, activations, and optimizer state. Cut Cross-Entropy evaluates the log-sum-exp on the fly in on-chip memory (Wijmans et al., 2025) and Liger-Kernel fuses the projection with crossentropy over chunked inputs (Hsu et al., 2024), both resting on the online-softmax recurrence (Milakov and Gimelshein, 2018) behind FlashAttention (Dao et al., 2022), while Megatrons vocabulary-parallel cross-entropy shards the weight and reduces per-shard statistics across tensor-parallel ranks (Shoeybi et al., 2019). Each assumes away the case Ring-DTP addresses, since the fused kernels loop over batch resident on one device and the vocabulary-parallel reduction needs replicated batch, so no schedule is required; Ring Attention circulates key-value blocks around ring (Liu et al., 2024), where no payload choice arises because only one operand can move. For activations, checkpointing and rematerialization reduce retained interiors (Chen et al., 2016; Jain et al., 2020; Kirisame et al., 2021), hooks and swapping relocate them (PyTorch Contributors, 2026a; Peng et al., 2020), and DeepSpeed (DeepSpeed Team, 2026) and PyTorch (PyTorch Contributors, 2026b) offload checkpoint regions wholesale, whereas SCO offloads host-budget subset of checkpoint boundaries and prefetches them one layer ahead. ZeRO-Offload and ZeRO-Infinity move optimizer state and its update to lower tiers (Ren et al., 2021; Rajbhandari et al., 2021), while 8-bit quantization (Dettmers et al., 2022) and block-shared learning rates (Zhang et al., 2025) shrink it by changing numerics, which this setting excludes.

sections.title: 6 CONCLUSION
sections.content: MoE training at long context or large batch size fails for four unrelated reasons whose relative heights move with the configuration, so stack is usable only when every one of them has bound and none of the bounds is mandatory. We gave each schedule whose GPU working set follows from launch configuration: per-source token budget for dispatch, ring of vocabulary meetings, host-budget checkpoint-boundary offload, and bucket pipeline for the offloaded update. Together they yield closed-form per-rank budget in which every term is fixed once the token ceiling is set, and matched component tests show each bound holding at throughput cost we measure. Composed inside the MoP rank layout at 120B, 241B, and 667B, the stack trains at one-million-token context where tuned FSDP2 baseline runs out of memory between 32K and 128K, and spends the memory it saves on larger batch as readily as on longer context.

sections.title: 7 LIMITATIONS
sections.content: Four boundaries follow from occupying the memory-efficiency end of the space. All-to-all and ring traffic assumes fast interconnect, so the launch-count trade that makes additional chunks inexpensive on the intra-node NVLink measured here could differ across slower fabric. smaller token budget 10 Preprint Salesforce AI Research tightens the receiver bound and raises the chunk count by the same factor, and forward time is flat in the chunk count only over part of that range, so is selected from measured curve rather than minimized (Figure 8). Checkpoint and optimizer streaming spend host capacity and link bandwidth, which binds on nodes with less host memory than the 2 TB used here. Topology sensitivity and automatic selection of (D, Ep, P, c, β) remain open.

The fused kernel applies the same bias correction, weight decay, and update order as the reference implementation (Loshchilov and Hutter, 2019), and buckets are built once from parameter order, so ownership does not change between steps. Beginning bucket during backward instead of after it additionally requires the buckets gradient to be final and any cross-bucket transform to be known; global gradient clipping supplies the latter only once the global norm exists.
